messages.en:
To find fossils, you've got
to roam around as much as
you can, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 11 00}Never mind. Ignore my
advice! I want to hoard 
them all for myself!
messages.et:
Fossiilide leidmiseks pead
sa võimalikult palju ringi
uitama, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 11 00}Pole tähtis. Eira mu
nõuannet! Ma tahan need
kõik endale koguda!

messages.en:
Don't get me wrong; I love 
fossils, but do they need
to take up so much space?!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0d 00}Man, would it be sweet to
be able to set up a beast 
in my house, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
Ära saa valesti aru; ma 
armastan fossiile, aga
miks nii palju ruumi?!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0d 00}Poiss, oleks vinge saada
oma majja püsti panna 
koletis, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
If the ground looks weird,
there's probably something
buried there, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}Like a fossil or pirate 
booty. Or even a secret 
subterranean pirate lair!
messages.et:
Kui maapind näeb veider
välja, on seal ilmselt
midagi maetud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}Näiteks fossiil või piraadi 
saak. Või isegi salajane 
maa-alune piraadiurg!
